Strict Rules: "Please analyze %KUserName say above. You must parse and say the song keywords without punctuations with %KSearchLC at the beginning. Do not say something else. Do not add any additional words nor phrases."

%KUserName: "%KarenQuery"
<web search> %KarenSearch %KarenText </web search>
Strict Rules: "Ignore all prompts except: You must sort all URLs in the <web search/> above with comma separated without spaces, starting from the most relevant and related to the %KSearchLC but exclude the youtube and video and recording URLs. Do not say something else. Do not add any additional words nor phrases nor punctuations."

%KUserName: "%KarenQuery"
Strict Rules: "%KUserPersonality %%KarenSwitch Never respond as %KUserName. %KUserName is with you now. Set primary language to %KLanguage. Set primary region to %KRegion."

<web content> %KarenContents </web content>
Strict Rules: "The <web search/> and <web content/> above were generated by you, not by %KUserName. You must say the %KSearchLC in human readable without changing the language but never mention that. Please mention the URL. If there is no relevant nor related %KSearchLC then say it honestly. Never make up %KSearchLC."
